physical_convention.frequency_formula: unwrap(phase[n]-phase[n-1]) * actual_discriminator_rate_hz / (2*pi), then bounded FIR correction for sample-interval averaging
physical_convention.clock: The actual RF-decimated or IF-resampled clock; no post-IF restoration to the historical source-rate convention.
physical_convention.deviation_measurement: Half of the frequency span over completed 100 ms windows, with bounded three-point peak refinement; excludes initial 10 ms acquisition and carrier offset. Shared mono/stereo path; reset retires frequency/peak history.

paths: WFM stereo without pilot, equal-channel fallback
analytic_tone_sweep.input: Independent continuous FM phase integral, CF32 magnitude 0.5; 1 kHz tone, 2500 Hz NFM or 10000 Hz WFM peak deviation, 0.25 seconds.
analytic_tone_sweep.gain_measurement: Coherent 1 kHz amplitude after 150 ms acquisition; expected 0.5 NFM or 10000/75000 WFM.

continuous_stereo_multiplex.definition: Analytically integrate the continuous MPX, rather than Euler-integrating it at the tested sampling rate. L=0.08*cos(2*pi*1000*t), R=0.04*cos(2*pi*2000*t), sum/2 + difference/2*cos(2*pi*38000*t) + 0.1*cos(2*pi*19000*t).

implementation_notes: Normalize local NFM and WFM at the actual discriminator clock, using the daemon physical amplitude conventions. Mono, stereo, pre-deemphasis RDS and NFM subaudible taps share the normalized units.

The bounded 17-tap symmetric equalizer compensates sample-interval averaging; its DC gain is one. The continuous MPX fixture exposed high-frequency attenuation hidden by the older discrete phase-integrator fixture.

The IF path applies the RF channel filter once. Four-point causal Lagrange IQ interpolation preserves curvature during rate conversion and adds one input sample of delay without changing output counts.

Single-bin IF reconstruction uses measured envelope variation to blend with the identically delayed original center sample, preserving clean constant-envelope FM gain. Both branches use the same carrier units; the original FFT reference computation and the existing noisy-NFM improvement gate still pass.
Native RF decimation reuses the daemon linear-phase FIR decimator. The old IIR RF anti-alias filter distorted the stereo pilot/difference-channel phase relationship.
The older stereo clock test no longer computes a historical source-rate attenuation factor; it now checks physical audio amplitudes directly.
